description: Find an agent by describing your task in plain English and narrowing it over several turns ('only free ones', 'details 1', 'more', 'what's new', 'stop'). Keeps the conversation for your visitor token; replies are in English. Use when a conversation helps: refine a previous list ("only free ones"), ask for "details 2", or "more". Example arguments: {"message": "find a weather forecast API"} Ads: one "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` array, also in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]` and a last "Advertisement:" text line; results unchanged.

message.description: Plain-English request or follow-up, at most 2000 characters.

visitor_token.description: Your visitor token (vt_…) so I remember you. Omit on first contact.

name: chat

outputSchema.description: Fields vary by operation; check isError and status first.

direct_only.description: Not run by this gateway; not a recommendation.

sponsored.description: One labelled Advertisement, apart from the results; `disclosure` says paid or house. It does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only; never put it in answer text.

title: Ask about a task
